purpose: Bounded Fair Work Commission case summary preserving dismissal, documented unsuccessful alternative-employment search, known income loss, and an ordered compensation remedy without treating the order as payment receipt.

events.geography: Australia; IAA work-from-home employment case [2024] FWC 3523
events.date_precision: day; primary decision records dismissal date, unsuccessful job search, and compensation order payable by 2025-01-17
events.denominator: One publicly identified adjudicated worker case; no population denominator
events.method: Structured extraction from the primary Fair Work Commission decision and linked order reference
events.missingness: Worker identity beyond the public case name, alternative offers, search intensity, payment receipt, household outcome, trust, collective action, recurrence, and exit are not retained
events.exposure: The employer summarily dismissed a work-from-home employee during a redundancy-related dispute without meaningful consultation or an opportunity to explore alternatives
events.alternatives_before_action: The worker gave evidence that she had unsuccessfully sought work after dismissal; the decision also found she had no opportunity before dismissal to explore redeployment or other acceptable employment
events.immediate_burden_or_benefit: The Commission assessed eight weeks of lost income at $10,700, deducted two weeks of pay in lieu of notice, and set compensation at $8,025 gross plus superannuation
events.choice_or_response: The worker attempted to mitigate loss by seeking employment, sought reinstatement, and pursued an unfair-dismissal application; the Commission found reinstatement unworkable because the relationship had broken down
events.person_or_actor_with_control: Employer controlled dismissal and consultation; the worker controlled application and job-search effort; the Commission controlled the remedy decision
events.remedy_or_institutional_response: The Commission found the dismissal unfair, declined reinstatement, and ordered $8,025 less tax plus 11.5% superannuation, payable by 2025-01-17
events.durability_followup: No secured alternative employment was recorded by the hearing; later recovery, recurrence, trust, and exit are unknown
events.immediate_outcome: Unsuccessful alternative-employment search and an ordered compensation remedy are observed; payment receipt and work restoration are not
events.protected_outcome: The order recognizes a bounded lost-income period and provides a formal compensation route; the original work-from-home position is not restored
events.sacrificed_outcome: The worker lost employment and remained without secured alternative work during the assessed period; household, health, and time effects are not quantified
events.cost_risk_transfer: The worker carried unemployment and search costs until the order; the employer was assigned a gross compensation obligation subject to execution
events.later_outcome: The decision records no secured alternative employment by the hearing, and no later receipt, household recovery, recurrence, trust, action, switching, or exit is public
events.meaning_and_attribution: The decision records a breakdown in the employment relationship and employer-control failures, but no worker-reported trust, dignity, identity, or political-action endpoint
events.public_or_collective_response: An individual application and adjudicated compensation order are observed; no later collective or political response is reported
events.counterexample: A worker can actively seek alternative employment without securing it; an ordered compensation remedy does not establish payment or restore the original work arrangement
events.source_and_uncertainty: Primary Fair Work Commission decision [2024] FWC 3523, especially findings on dismissal, failed alternative-employment search, compensation calculation, and payment deadline; https://www.fwc.gov.au/documents/decisionssigned/pdf/2024fwc3523.pdf; payment receipt and post-order outcomes are not public

arrows.evidence: The decision finds no meaningful consultation or opportunity to explore alternatives before dismissal and records the worker's subsequent unsuccessful search for work
arrows.counterexample: An observed search effort does not establish the size of the opportunity set or whether any offer was feasible
arrows.remaining_gap: Search intensity, offers, constraints, non-use, and alternative-work availability

arrows.evidence: The Commission records no secured employment and calculates eight weeks of lost income, less two weeks of notice pay
arrows.counterexample: Known assessed loss does not capture household, health, dignity, or longer-term career effects
arrows.remaining_gap: Household incidence, duration beyond assessed window, health/time costs, and later work

arrows.evidence: The Commission ordered $8,025 less tax plus 11.5% superannuation with payment required by 2025-01-17
arrows.counterexample: An order and deadline are not proof of payment receipt or net recovery
arrows.remaining_gap: Payment execution, receipt, taxation, net amount, and residual loss

arrows.evidence: The public decision specifies an order and deadline but contains no later payment or household follow-up
arrows.counterexample: A formal order can coexist with nonpayment, delay, or inadequate net recovery
arrows.remaining_gap: Receipt, timing, net recovery, household security, and later employment

arrows.to: trust, action, recurrence, switching, or exit
arrows.evidence: The decision records relationship breakdown and no later worker-linked trust, recurrence, collective action, switching, or exit endpoint
arrows.counterexample: A legal remedy route may preserve formal accountability while leaving institutional trust and future work choices unresolved
arrows.remaining_gap: Worker meaning/trust, recurrence, collective response, switching, non-use, and exit

boundary: This ledger adds one primary adjudicated case with observed unsuccessful alternative-employment search, assessed income loss, and an ordered compensation remedy. It does not establish payment receipt, household recovery, trust, recurrence, action, switching, or exit.
storage_boundary: No claimant file, direct identifier beyond the public case reference, bulk archive, or payment instrument is retained; only bounded primary decision fields, dates, remedy calculation, uncertainty, and open downstream arrows are represented.
